Text continues to appear at the bottom. (4) A wide shot shows two cats—one orange-and-white and one black-and-white—sitting on a light wood floor under a dark piece of furniture. The background shows wooden shelving and a clean home environment. (5) A tortoiseshell cat is shown sitting on a tan mat, looking towards a white tunnel, followed by a black-and-white cat walking across a spacious wooden floor towards the camera. (8) The final sequence features a tabby cat showing 'airplane ears' while lying on a light blue pillow, followed by a white cat resting on a wooden ledge, looking directly into the camera as the final text appears.
